description: This Python module is a deprecated service aggregator that re-exports various AI-related services from individual modules and serves as an alias via a proxy. It also contains licensing information and documentation indicating deprecation.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class used to mark the module as deprecated and redirect imports to the specified services.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for DeprecatedModuleProxy, sets up the module deprecation proxy and handles export redirection.
